method: Read complete current four-module production diffs against Ralph-fetched prior source, the modified functions and measured-placement helper, and governing endpoint-intent/allowed-label policy; independently assess conditions and hard gates. Read exact subsequent timer-output alternative diff and its generic local-motif geometry rationale.

findings.basis: Power endpoint labels follow typed power_in/power_out roles and exclude generated reference-divider nets. Labels are actual emitted scope-correct conductor contacts with measured full text/body clearance. Internal reference distribution remains explicit. Timer control-bypass relocation and left-access alternatives preserve the physical terminal inventory and topology; dimensions are fragment-template geometry, not fixture-dependent dispatch. Timer output alternatives exclude inward left escapes folding into the owned right-facing output-pin corridor; upward/downward/outward access and left supply alternatives remain available. This is family/port-role dispatch, with no fixture-specific branch.

Package backfill uses actual source offsets and all horizontally overlapping occupied extents, then reserves one pitch for independently snapped envelope origins. Generated-power column candidates derive from distributive semantics, exactly one typed producer, measured envelopes, and precedence gateways; no fixture/net-name dispatch. Existing page/content/spread/overlap checks and eight retained-seed limit remain. Packing provenance now records the actual certified width/height.

External precedence repair closes the owning physical-package and typed signal/branch/support group. Atomic translations can relocate one actually blocking interface in finitely enumerated measured slots. Every proposal rechecks all physical-terminal precedence/local-span obligations, page/content bounds, and all fragment overlaps through _measured_repack. It does not relax constraints for the triggering fixture or bypass the 32-complete-attempt limit.

Shared-tree selection derives from typed power edges with at least three owners and a typed producer, plus existing explicit-reference nets. Same-net label/wire/protected reservations follow pre-existing admitted-net logic; body/cross-net restrictions remain. A new guard prevents unlabeled dangling escape tips only on shared-tree nets. Endpoint intent comes from actual emitted label contacts, not a waiver or internal success label. Ordinary two-terminal signal feasibility remains unchanged.

limits: Engineering/agent source inspection, not human approval.
Independent AST/literal audits, fresh complete five-run qualification, observed structural/triple coverage, historical hash preservation and actual final renders remain required.
